passage: Last Sunday morning, I visited the old flea market near the river. I wanted to buy a used bike for my son. The market opened at eight, and hundreds of people walked around the stalls. I looked at many bikes. Some looked too old, and some cost too much. At a small stall, an old man smiled and waved to me. He showed me a blue bike and asked me to try it. I rode it around the square and felt happy. The brakes worked well, but the seat looked a little broken. The old man laughed and fixed the seat for me in five minutes. Then he cleaned the bike with a wet cloth and filled the tires with air. I paid him three hundred yuan and thanked him many times. On the way home, I picked up some fruit for my wife. My son rode the bike all afternoon.
